senses.gloss: ch. = h.גָּרָםcause.—מ״ע שהזמן ג׳ (in Hebr. diction) a positive command the observance of which depends on a certain time of the day or season of the year.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 1:7">Kidd. I, 7</cite> (<cite ref="Kiddushin 29a:7">29ᵃ</cite>); a. fr.

<cite ref="Shabbat 120b:2">Sabb. 120ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ שרי</he> indirect effect (e.g. effacing the Divine Name in consequence of bathing) is permitted, opp. <cite ref="P01476"><he>עשייה</he></cite> the direct act.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 60a:7">B. Kam. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>ג׳ בניזקין פטור</he> damage by indirect action is not actionable.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 22b:12">B. Bath. 22ᵇ</cite> <he>ג׳ בניזקין אסור</he> to cause indirect damage is forbidden.—Pl. <cite ref="C01358"><he>גְּרָמֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 98b:5">B. Kam. 98ᵇ</cite> <he>מאן דדאין דינא דג׳</he> he who holds the opinion that one who is the cause of damage to another person is responsible; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 100a">ib. 100ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Kamma 117b">117ᵇ</cite>; a. e.
